ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of low-intensity (dark) to high-intensity (light) pixels; dominated by dark pigmentation with high-contrast white scarring and distal mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity region across the central 70% of the fluke; high-intensity, mottled pixel clusters located at the distal 15% of both lobes; linear high-intensity streaks distributed across both hemispheres.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 40-45 degrees; deep vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration; peak-to-valley pixel amplitude increases significantly toward the distal tips, while the region proximal to the notch remains relatively low-frequency.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave-to-convex curve transition from the median notch to the vertically oriented distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, roughly circular pixel clusters forming raised textures at the extreme distal points of both lobes (consistent with barnacle colonization).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of unaligned, high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated primarily on the mid-to-outer regions of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent multi-directional rake marks across both lobes and significant calcified-like clusters at the fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive high-density scarring pattern on the right lobe (image-left) featuring parallel vertical linear abrasions.
